svg.title: Push operation in a stack, six-stage sequence
svg.desc: Diagram showing six stages of stack push operations: empty stack, then after pushing 10, 20, 30, and 50 in sequence. The final stage shows an attempted push(60) operation resulting in a Stack Overflow error. Each stage shows the top pointer index.
svg.text: Highlighted box = element just pushed · Top pointer index always points to it
